name: Areeb Kamran
headline: Data Management & Strategy Consultant | SAP | CDTM | TUM
summary:
With over 12 years of experience in the consulting and audit industry, I am SAP professional with a focus on data management, migration and data science & analytics who is also passionate about sustainability and digital transformation. I have worked with clients from fashion & textile, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, telecom, and software industries, delivering high-quality solutions and insights.

In data management roles, I have applied my skills in data analytics, machine learning, and IT audit to manage migrations to SAP S/4 HANA, support technical integration of ERP and non ERP data sources, setting up data governance structures and the digitization of sustainability and non-financial reporting data. I have also lead agile product development of data-centric managed-services and internal tools. 

I am always eager to dive into new technologies and methodologies, and to collaborate with globally diverse and talented teams. My goal is to leverage my expertise in SAP and data science to enable digitalization leading to positive impact and value for the business, society and the environment.

company.description:
PwC is the leading auditing and consulting company in Germany. As an independent member of the international PwC network, it offers its services worldwide.

PwC audits and advises leading industrial and service companies of all sizes. In Germany, over 15,000 employees generate revenues of more than three billion euros in the divisions of audit and audit-related services (assurance solutions), tax and legal advice (tax & legal solutions), transformation, risk & regulatory, sustainability, cloud & digital, and deals. The experts in the different service lines work together across all divisions and from different offices in Germany, making it possible to meet with them individually at 20 locations nationwide.

Also part of PwC is Strategy& – a global team of practice-oriented strategists. You can find more information about our team of strategy advisors here: https://www.strategyand.pwc.com/

Thanks to its worldwide network, PwC is able to provide its clients with professional services around the world and to offer cross-border support. As an independent member of this network, PwC Germany has access to more than 365,000 employees in 136 countries.

You can find current vacancies at PwC Germany and information on PwC’s different divisions on our career page:  www.karriere.pwc.de
